height: 35px; min-height: 35px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding-block: 0px;
height: var(--toolbar-control-height); min-height: var(--toolbar-control-height); padding-block: 0px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px;
